title: 美国高成本追AGI：中国把AI当公共品，应用端机会怎么抓？
speaker: Kendra Lau

segments.en: What about the peer play AI? They've been hit quite hard, right?
segments.zh: 那同行AI表现如何？它们受到较大冲击，对吧？

segments.en: Because they're not as technology advanced as the US.
segments.zh: 因为它们在技术上不如美国先进。

segments.en: You still have the likes of deep-seek that seem to be still leading the charge that are not listed companies yet.
segments.zh: 你还有像DeepSeek这样的公司似乎仍在领跑，但它们尚未上市。

segments.en: And that really kind of leaves the likes of Jirupu, the likes of Mini Max, and kind of a limbo there.
segments.zh: 这就让像智谱、MiniMax这样的公司处于一种悬而未决的状态。

segments.en: They're just kind of just dragging behind me. How should I look at peer plays?
segments.zh: 它们只是有点落后。我该如何看待同行表现？

segments.en: I would say we look at the US.
I think basically, US and China are taking very different approaches when it comes to developing AI.
segments.zh: 我认为基本上，美国和中国在发展AI方面采取了非常不同的方式。

segments.en: Obviously, in the US, it's more like a high cost and properly high return model.
segments.zh: 显然，在美国，这更像是一种高成本、高回报的模式。

segments.en: For example, again, other leading companies are trying to create AGI ASI.
segments.zh: 例如，其他领先公司正试图创造AGI、ASI。

segments.en: But for China, I think AI is perceived or regarded as a public good.
segments.zh: 但对中国来说，我认为AI被视为一种公共产品。

segments.en: That's why we have open source model, open weight model.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们有开源模型、开放权重模型。

segments.en: You don't make money basically charging very high margins.
segments.zh: 你基本上不是靠收取高利润率来赚钱。

segments.en: But you make money from volume.
So when it comes to trying that every time policymakers talk about AI, it comes with a plus.
segments.zh: 所以每当政策制定者谈到人工智能时，都会带一个加号。

segments.en: So that's why in our report, we really try to emphasize, besides the hardware cohorts, we think that applications could be the way to go.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么在我们的报告中，我们真正试图强调，除了硬件板块，我们认为应用可能是发展方向。
